propositions: completion.py and completion_recovery.py have reached the 800-LOC CI module-size cap and cannot accept further edits without architectural refactoring

completion.py contains four distinct concerns (operation orchestration, child-closure gate, epic-bug-screen logic, verdict reconciliation) that should be separated into focused modules with clear contracts
completion_recovery.py contains three distinct concerns (criteria surface and coverage contract, failure taxonomy, recovery orchestration) that should be separated into focused modules
the refactor must preserve all public API seams via re-exports so that existing callers in gate_ops, tests, and internal modules remain importable from their current paths
all moved symbols must remain patchable at their runtime call sites, verified by string-sweep across source and tests for monkeypatch targets and import statements
